When the stalk switch wheel is operated with the key ON, the side lights or number plate lights do not work

STEP

OPERATIONS TO BE CARRIED OUT

TEST RESULTS

1

INDIVIDUAL LIGHT CHECK

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check condition of the bulbs and associated bulb holder unit

Move on to Step

1. Front bulbs damaged

1. Change the bulbs

Op. 5540B28 BULB (1) FOR FRONT TURN SIGNAL IN A HEAD LAMP (1), LH OR RH - R R

2. Rear bulbs damaged

2. Change the bulbs

Op. 5540A74 BULB OF A SIDELIGHT OR FOG LAMP OR REVERSING LIGHT IN A TAIL-LIGHT, LH OR RH R R

3. Tail-light fault

3. Repair or replace the tail-light

Op. 5540A44 L/H OR R/H TAIL LIGHT (ONE) - R+R

4. Front light cluster fault

4. Repair or replace the front light cluster

Op. 5540B10 EXTERIOR LIGHT DIMMER RESISTOR - R+R

5. Number plate light fault

5. Repair or replace the number plate lights

Op. 5540A94 L/H OR R/H NUMBER PLATE LIGHT (ONE) - R+R

2

SIDE LIGHT ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT CHECK

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check the following, in order:

  • side light fuses;
  • connections between battery, engine bay control unit, ignition switch, stalk unit and underfacia junction unit;
  • connections between underfacia junction unit and bulbs;
  • bulb earth

Move on to Step

1. Component defective

1. Replace defective component (in the case of a fuse, find out what caused it to blow)

2. Connections interrupted

2. Repair the connections

See E2010 SIDE LIGHTS / NO. PLATE LIGHTS

3

STEERING COLUMN SWITCH UNIT CHECK

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check that a battery voltage output is generated to supply the side/number plate lights when the stalk switch wheel is operated with the key on.

See E2010 SIDE LIGHTS / NO. PLATE LIGHTS

Move on to Step

Stalk switch not working properly

Replace the steering column switch unit

Op. 5550A12 COMPLETE STALK UNIT - R+R FOR VERSIONS WITH AIR BAG

4

IGNITION SWITCH CHECK

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check that a battery voltage is generated when the ignition key is turned on and more specifically to the stalk switch that supplies the side/number plate lights

See E2010 SIDE LIGHTS / NO. PLATE LIGHTS

Move on to Step

Fault in ignition switch

Repair or replace the ignition switch

Op. 5520A12 IGNITION SWITCH ASSEMBLY - R R FOR VERSIONS WITH AIR BAG

5

UNDERFACIA JUNCTION UNIT CHECK

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check that a battery voltage output is generated from the underfacia junction unit to control the bulbs when the stalk switch wheel is operated with the key on

See E2010 SIDE LIGHTS / NO. PLATE LIGHTS

Move on to Step

Fault in the underfacia junction unit

Repair or replace the underfacia junction unit

6

CHECK ON CORRECT OPERATION

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check that the fault is no longer present
